text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Multiple organized paragraphs","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay is divided into several paragraphs that separate ideas into distinct sections rather than running everything together."},{"evidence":"Topic-shifting transition phrases","quality":"coherence","description":"The writer uses clear transitions like 'First thing' and 'Last thing I have to say' to guide the reader through the essay's points."},{"evidence":"Sentence variety beyond listing","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay develops each point with explanation and examples instead of mainly stacking simple activity phrases."},{"evidence":"More complete sentence structures","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing shows more control over sentence boundaries and clause structure, even though errors remain frequent."},{"evidence":"Less repetitive 'and stuff' chaining","quality":"lexical control","description":"The essay relies less on repetitive filler phrasing and shows somewhat broader word choice."}]}
